svg.title: A diagram of a whole-school inclusion model as three concentric rings around one named child in one classroom - an inner ring of the room with the teacher, class, pupil and family, a middle ring of the school with the head teacher, last year's teacher, monitoring and the staff room, and an outer ring beyond the gate with the visiting specialist, health services, the education office and disability organisations - with a bold escalation arrow leaving the outer ring and a dashed arrow showing that anything arriving from outside reaches the child only through the teacher, and a footer noting the inner two rings are available this term while the outer is a letter and a wait.
svg.desc: A diagram of a whole-school inclusion model as three concentric rings around one named child in one classroom - an inner ring of the room with the teacher, class, pupil and family, a middle ring of the school with the head teacher, last year's teacher, monitoring and the staff room, and an outer ring beyond the gate with the visiting specialist, health services, the education office and disability organisations - with a bold escalation arrow leaving the outer ring and a dashed arrow showing that anything arriving from outside reaches the child only through the teacher, and a footer noting the inner two rings are available this term while the outer is a letter and a wait.
svg.text: Teacher: seating, attention routine, key word, expectations.
Class: charter, buddy rota, assigned pairs, instruction check.
Pupil: ask what helps and believe her.
Family: four questions, one free weekly action, non-reading channel.
Head: register, room, timetable, request signature.
Monitoring: participation and attainment, two lines per term, s.9(1).
Staff room: seven-second correction; do not label family uninterested.
Special educator: watch, plan, then brief work.
Health services and Lady Health Worker: assessment/devices information;
Education office: trained posts, works, survey.
Disability organisations and other families: information, advocacy and
Bold outward arrow: name pupil, cite clause, keep copy. Dashed inward
arrow: outside support reaches the child through the teacher. Start Rings
1–2 now; request Ring 3 rather than waiting.
